generator: GPT-6 Astra Pro (session-declared; exact API ID unavailable)
generator_context: fresh session per method, four cases per session; no cross-method candidates
review_plan: Two separate GPT review sessions, method labels hidden, frozen input and output hashes bound; conservative adjudication keeps disagreements visible.

score_scale.1: mostly supported with a material omission

primary_reporting: Per-case and per-method dimension scores and critical failures. No downstream or population superiority claim.

budget.actual_model_calls_observable: session count only; no exact token telemetry

review_binding: candidate_sha256 binds trial, coordinator arm, comparison unit, frozen input, effective instruction and target; arm label is hidden from reviewers
format_repair_policy: Do not alter generated content; an invalid output stays visible and counts as invalid.
ties: report all tied arms; never call a tie superiority
independence_limit: 4 event families, only 2 connected source-document clusters; no population or p-value claim.
ablation_limit: M5/M6/M7 share strengthened DGSI evidence-role/scope policy; comparisons between them isolate recipe components, while comparison to frozen M4 includes that policy refinement.
stopping_rule: End after all six frozen arms and two GPT reviews, regardless of rank; no tuning on these forward cases.
